data.name: Oniria Dreamscapes
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Oniria Dreamscapes, a cozy city-builder set on a surreal spherical world. Create your city and expand your territory across a globe shaped by the dreams. Explore hidden regions, and manage the destiny of Oniria through mysterious events and meaningful choices.

🎨 Craft Your Dream Settlement

Construct a unique surreal city at your own pace. Design your settlement with intuitive voxel architecture, featuring more than 30 buildings already available to create diverse environments, with over 100 buildings planned as the experience continues to expand across ever-growing dreamscapes.

🌎 Explore a world that dreams

An immersive planet that awakens as you build. Expand into new territories, reveal forgotten landscapes, and uncover secrets buried beneath the surface of Oniria.

📖 Live handcrafted stories

Discover strange inhabitants, unlock lost places, and face unexpected dilemmas through hundreds of unique events. Your decisions define how Oniria grows.

⚖️ Balance dreams and nightmares

Growth brings challenges. Manage resources, face unpredictable events, and maintain harmony between dreams and nightmares as your world transforms.

🌙 Shape the future of Oniria

Every horizon hides another mystery. Expand, explore, and leave your mark on a planet that dreams of its own awakening.

🛏️ Dream Without Fear

Tailor your dream to match your mood. Disable nightmares or crime to create a peaceful, cozy experience where exploration and creativity take center stage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 o AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
